spans.s:
m. (-रः)
1 Man, individually or generally.
2 The Eternal, the divine imperishable spirit pervading the universe.
3 A name of

ARJUNA.
4
VIṢṆ

A gnomon.
6 A man or piece at chess, draughts, &c.
7 A Muni, an incarnation of VIṢṆU.
n. (-रं)
A fragrant grass, commonly Rāmkapūr.
f. (-री)
Woman in general: see नारी.
E.
नृ to lead or guide, affix अच्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Relating to men, human, mortal, &c.
2 Spiritual.
nf. (-रं-रा)
Water.
m. (-रः)
A calf.
n. (-रं)
A multitude of men.
E.
नर, and अण् affix or न negative, ऋ to go, अप् aff.

mn. (-कः-कं)
Hell, the infernal regions, including a number of places of torture of various descriptions.
m. (-कः)
The name of a Daitya or demon.
E.
नृ to guide or lead, affix वुन्, whither the wicked are conducted: sometimes read नारक.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Infernal, hellish.
m. (-कः)
Hell or the infernal regions.
E.
नरक hell, अण् aff.

n. (-ण्डं)
A well or pit in Tartarus, eighty-six such are enumerated.
E.
नरक, and कुण्ड a pit.

m. (-जित्)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
नरक the demon, and जित् subduing.

f. (-ता)
Misfortune, personified as a goddess.
E.
नरक, and देवता divinity.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Living or being in Tartarus, who or what is there.
f. (-स्था)
The river of hell.
E.
नरक hell, स्थ who stays or abides, fem. affix टाप्.

m. (-कः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
नरक hell, and अन्तक destroyer.

m. (-यः)
The soul after death.
E.
नरक hell, and आमव sickness.

m. (-कः)
The murderer of his spiritual preceptor.
E.
नर mankind, and कील a stake, affix कन्.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Pimples on the face.
n. (-ङ्गं)
The penis.
E.
नृ to guide or lead, Uṇādi affix अङ्ग.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 The juice of the pepper plant.
2 An animal, one of twins.
3 A catamite.
4 The orange tree.
E.
नार many men, and ग who goes.

m. (-वः)
A sovereign, a king.
E.
नर a man, and देव a deity.

m. dual. (-णौ)
Two sages, incarnations of VIṢṆU, and born again, as KṚṢṆA and ARJUNA.
E.
नर, and नारायण, each severally the name of a sage.

m. (-तिः)
A king, a sovereign prince.
E.
नर man, पति lord.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Favourable or friendly to mankind.
E.
नर, and प्रिय fond of.

f. (-भूः)
Bharata Varṣa, India, or the central part of the known continent.
2 The birth or birthplace of men.
E.
नर man, and भू land; also नरभूमि f. (-मिः)

f. (-नी)
A woman who has a beard.
E.
नर a man, मन to regard or think, and णिनि affix; also with कन् affix in the feminine form, नरमानिका; these words are also written नरमालिनी, &c.

f. (-ला)
A string or girdle of skulls.
E.
नर, and माला a garland.

f. (-नी)
A woman with a beard.
E.
नर a man, माला a necklace, इनि aff.

m. (-धः)
A human sacrifice.
E.
नर, and मेध a sacrifice.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Borne or carried by men.
m. (-नः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
नर a man, and वाहन a vehicle.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Carried by men, (a vehicle.)
E.
नर, and वाहिन् what bears.

m. (-णः)
An imp or goblin.
E.
नर man, and विष्वण who devours.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
Having the form of man.
n. (-पं)
The human form.
E.
नर, and रूप form.

mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि)
Having the human form.
E.
नररूप, and इनि aff.

m. (-हः)
1 VIṢṆU in his fourth Avatāra or descent, the lion-headed man.
2 A chief, a man of eminence or power.
E.
नर a man, and सिंह a lion.

m. (-रिः)
VIṢṆU in his fourth Avatar: see the last.
E.
नर, and हरि a lion.

m. (-मः)
A low or vile man, a wretch.
E.
नर, and अधम low.

f. (-रा)
The earth.
E.
नर man, आधार receptacle.

m. (-पः)
A king.
E.
नर, and अधिप ruler.

Death.
2

A Rākṣasa, a son of RĀVAṆA.
E.
नर, and अन्तक destroyer.

m. (-णः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
नर man, and अयण going: see नारायण.

m. (-णः)
1 A name of VIṢṆU, but especially considered as the deity who was before all worlds.
2 A sage, the son of DHARMA, a manifestation of VIṢṆ

A valiant combatant.
f. (-णी)
1 A name of

DURGĀ.
2
A name of LAKṢMĪ, the goddess of prosperity, and wife of VIṢṆ
GAṄ

GĀ.
4

A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.)
E.
नारा the primeval waters, derived from नर the spirit of God, whence they originated, and अयन place of coming or moving; he who moved over the waters before creation: the word has several etymologies, as नर the spirit or soul of the universe, अण् affix, नार appertaining to it, the actions or emotions of the soul, and अयन pervading, influencing; again नार multitudes, mankind, and अयन place: present amongst all men, &c.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 A king, an anointed sovereign.
2 A dealer in antidotes, a juggler.
E.
नर a man, इन्द्र chief.

m. (-शः)
A king.
E.
नर, and ईश master.

m. (-रः)
A king.
E.
नर, and ईश्वर a sovereign.

n. (-कं)
The nose.

m. (-कः)
1 An actor, a mime.
2 A juggler, a dancer, a player of any description.
3 A bard, a herald.
4 An elephant.
5 A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.)
5 A peacock.
f. (-की)
1 An actress, female dancer or singing girl.
2 A female elephant.
3 A peahen.
E.
नृत to dance or act, ष्वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Dancing, gesticulating, acting.
E.
नृत to dance, &c. affix ल्युट्.

m. (-यः)
A peacock.
E.
नर्त्तन dancing, and प्रिय fond of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Danced, dancing.
E.
नृत to dance, क्त aff.

r. 1st cl. (नर्द्दति प्रनर्द्दति)
To sound: the radical न is not convertible to ण after a preposition, &c. see णर्द्द.

n. (-कं)
A kind of metre, containing eight feet of various syllabic quantities.

mfn. (-र्द्दन्-र्द्दन्ती-र्द्दत्)
1

Sounding.
2

Praising aloud, proclaiming.
E.
नर्द्द, and शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Sounding, roaring, making a noise.
2 Celebrating, praising aloud.
E.
नर्द्द to sound, affix ल्युट.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be sounded.
2 To be celebrated or praised aloud.
E.
नर्द्द sound, and अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sounded, made as a noise.
2 Celebrated, praised aloud.
n. (-तं)
Sound, roar, bellowing.
E.
नर्द्द to sound, क्त aff.

m. (-कं)
A stanza of four parts, having seventeen syllables in each.

r. 1st. cl. (नर्ब्बति)
To go, to move.

m. (-लः)
A husband.
E.
नर्म्म amusement, कील a prop or stay.

m. (-र्भः)
A secret lover.
E.
नर्म्म, and गर्भ source.

m. (-टः)
1 The sun.
2 A potsherd.
E.
नर्म्म, and अट what goes, deriv. irr.

m. (-ठः)
1 The nipple.
2 A rake, a lecher, a libertine.
3 Sport, amusement.
4 Coition.
E.
नर्म्म pleasure, स्था to abide, ड affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Delighting, making happy, giving pleasure.
m. (-दः)
The associate or companion of a person's sports or amusements.
f. (-दा)
1 The Narmadā river, which rising in the Vindhyā mountains, runs westward to the gulf of

Cambay.
2

A plant: see पृक्का.
E.
नर्म्म pleasure, and द what gives.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Happy, merry.
f. (-तिः)
Enjoyment of a joke or any amusement.
E.
नर्म्म, and द्युति lustre.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Sport, amusement, pastime, diversion.
2 Jest, joke.
3 Wit, humour.
E.
नृ to guide, affix मनिन्.

m. (-वः)
A companion, an associate, the promoter and partaker of a person's amusements, especially of a prince or man of rank.
E.
नर्म्मन्, and सचिव a minister.

n. (-व्यं)
Superintendence or provision of a prince's amusements, partaking a person's amusements.
E.
नर्म्मसाचिव, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-र्ज्जः)
Happiness or amusement ending in alarm.
E.
नर्म्म, and स्फूर्ज्ज thundering.

m. (-टः)
Slight or inferior amusement.
E.
नर्म्म, and स्फोट opening.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
Infernal, being in hell, condemned to or deserving it.
E.
नारक, and इनि aff.

m. (-टः)
1 A sort of worm.
2 A deceiver, one who disappoints expectations excited by himself.

m. (-दः)
A name of NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and one of the ten divine Munis or Ṛṣis; he is a friend of KṚṢṆA, a celebrated legislator, and inventor of the Vīṇā or lute.
E.
नार men, and दा to give, (instruction,) ड affix; or नार water, and द who gives; offering sacrifices to the manes.

m. (-त्रः)
1 An iron arrow. (E. नार men, आङ् before चम to eat or consume, affix ड; destroying hosts of men.)
2 A bad or cloudy day.
3 A species of the Dhṛti metre. (E. नार water, आचम to spit, affix ड.)
f. (-त्री)
A goldsmith's scales, a fine or assay balance.
E.
नाराच an iron arrow, and ङीष् diminutive affix; also with कन् added in the fem. form, नाराचिका f. (-का)

n. (-त्रं)
Four cubits on either side of the stream of the Ganges.
E.
नारायण, and क्षेत्र shrine.

n. (-लं)
An oil of great reputed efficacy in many complaints, expressed from a variety of plants.
E.
नारायण, and तैल oil.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Attached to KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU.
m. (-यः)
ŚIVA.
E.
नारायण, and प्रिय fond of.

n. (-स्त्रं)
A weapon of undefined form and mystical nature.
E.
नारायण, and अस्त्र weapon.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Watery, aqueous.
2 Spiritual.
E.
नर or नार, and ठक् aff.

m. (-रः)
The cocoanut: see the next.

mf. (-लः-ली)
The cocoanut.
E.
नारिक watery (place), ईर to go or grow, affix क, and र optionally changed to ल; also with इन, नारिकेलि, and ड being substituted for र, नाडिकेर, &c.

mf. (-लः-ली)
The cocoanut.
f. (-ली)
Fermented liquor made from the water of the cocoanut: see नारिकेल, &c.

f. (-री)
1 A woman in general, a female.
2 A species of the Madhya metre.
E.
नर a man, अञ् and ङीप् aff.

m. (-चः)
A king of the solar line, the son of AŚMAKA.

n. (-चं)
An esculent root, Arum colocasia: see नाडीच.

m. (-कः)
A catamite.
E.
नारी a woman, तरङ्ग capricious, and कन् affix of comparison.

n. (-णं)
A vice or breach of duty in a woman, of which six cases are reckoned, drinking spirits, keeping bad company, quitting a husband, rambling abroad, and sleeping or dwelling in a strange house.
E.
नारी a woman, दूषण defect.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Libertinism, lechery.
E.
नारी, and प्रसङ्ग addiction.

n. (-नं)
A litter or other conveyance for women.
E.
नारी, and यान a carriage.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The orange tree; also नागरङ्ग.
